notes: Spark-X2.6-1.7B_int4-mlp.litertlm of litert-community/Spark-X2.6-1.7B: the mixed INT4 / INT8 file of the 1.7B, the faster 1.7B file on the Galaxy S26 GPU. XHToken/Spark-X2.6-1.7B (Apache-2.0) converted to LiteRT-LM; the bundle carries templates/spark26_think.jinja (the vendor template's plain-chat part, thinking on by default, reasoning_effort high or low through extra_context), a `thought` channel, 15 stop entries and the repo's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Published 2026-10-31 (Hub main 9b9bd0f4).
quantization: mixed INT4 / INT8 (dynamic, FP32 activations declared): attention FULLY_CONNECTED INT8 per channel, MLP gate / up INT4 blockwise-32 with OCTAV scales floored at 2^-14, MLP down and lm_head INT8, the embedding INT8 in its own TFLite section; litert-torch 0.9.3 export, GPU graph rewrite (KV writes -> odml.cache_update, attention products -> odml.runtime_bmm, weights byte-equal), prefer_activation_type fp32 on the decoder section, 11 prefill signatures, KV cache 4,096
